articles.title: Delhi High Court declines urgent hearing of plea on police brutality on CJP protesters
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court declined to urgently hear a petition alleging "excessive force" by city police against students. The petition pertains to police actions during a protest by the 'Cockroach Janta Party'. While not dismissed, the case will not be fast-tracked. This reflects ongoing legal scrutiny of police conduct and citizen rights during public demonstrations, a vital national issue for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Japan raises safety concern over Chinese destroyer's live-fire drills
articles.summary: Japan expressed concern after a Chinese navy destroyer conducted live-fire drills near a remote Japanese island in the Pacific Ocean. These drills, part of a joint naval exercise with Russia, occurred on Sunday. Tokyo views such activities as a significant challenge to its territorial integrity and regional stability, highlighting escalating military tensions and prompting calls for increased vigilance regarding China's expanding naval presence.

articles.title: NSA Ajit Doval meets Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan; discusses energy security and regional situation
articles.summary: India's NSA Ajit Doval visited Saudi Arabia, meeting Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan. Key discussions focused on strengthening energy security and protecting vital maritime corridors. This engagement underscores India's strategic foreign policy in fostering robust partnerships in the Middle East, crucial for regional stability, securing energy supplies, and directly impacting national security interests.

articles.title: Iran’s Nuclear Facilities Have Been Obliterated — and Suggestions Otherwise are Fake News
articles.summary: The White House officially declared on June 25, 2025, that Iran's nuclear facilities have been "obliterated," dismissing any contrary reports as "fake news." This significant statement from the US government suggests a major shift in international security dynamics and global nuclear proliferation concerns, with profound implications for regional stability and US-Iran relations.

articles.title: Recent Op-Eds, Opinion Pieces & Articles Worth Reading
articles.summary: The Himalayan Times featured an article by Shashi P.B.B. Malla, analyzing Rudramani Pokherel's discussion on Nepal's national symbol debate. The contentious issue revolves around choosing between the sacred cow and the rhino. This debate highlights the profound cultural and symbolic significance each animal holds for the nation, reflecting a deep-seated national dialogue on identity.

articles.title: Russian warship carried out firing exercise off Plymouth coast
articles.summary: A Russian warship conducted a live-fire artillery exercise just 40 nautical miles south of Plymouth on Monday, under close surveillance by a Royal Navy vessel. This incident underscores the strategic significance of naval operations near national borders and the constant need for vigilance and monitoring by defence forces, vital insights for SSB aspirants.
